paragraphs: MedicsCloud authorized users can generate the Electronic Health Information Export (EHI) for a single patient and also the patient population in both HL7 CCDA  xml format that comply with USCDI v1 requirements standards and HL7 FHIR v 4.0.1 US Core v 3.1.1.
